title: Git & Version Control Basics
intro: Git interview questions for freshers are asked at practically every Python developer interview because version control is table stakes — if you don't know Git, you can't be on a team. This page covers the three areas Git questions cluster into at fresher level: the daily workflow (init, add, commit, status, log, diff — what each command does and when), the branching model (why branches exist, how to create and switch with git branch and git checkout, what merge does, and why you get a conflict when two people edit the same line), and the remote workflow (clone, push, pull, fetch — and the difference between pull and fetch that interviewers love to ask). It also covers the merge vs rebase conceptual distinction (you don't need to know the rebase command cold, but you need to know that rebase rewrites history and merge preserves it), and the typical GitHub pull-request workflow that production teams use.
